ops.title: Trace and reduce recurring CCI daemon database writes
ops.description: Owner root; held behind the active controller CPU repair. Natural10-second sample controller-index-natural-after.json at03:14 Pacific on2026-11-16 recorded cc-inbox daemon52878 writing23.14MiB/s and reading0.95MiB/s at13.4percent CPU. This does not yet prove physical disk attribution or recurrence. Next executable step: resample natural per-process IO, identify the exact CCI SQLite/other files and request responsible, then remove redundant writes at their source while preserving message delivery.

ops.text: Natural activity identifies the write-producing request and file, with a bounded regression for the underlying redundancy
Fix merged released installed unquarantined and active daemon source/version verified
Equivalent natural affected operation remeasured without load tests or lost messages
